purpose: The client waits longer for the payments provider before giving up.

essential_behavior_changes.name: Outbound request timeout raised
essential_behavior_changes.description: The HTTP client used for the payments provider now allows 30 seconds instead of 5 before a request fails.

important_components.name: Payments HTTP client
important_components.description: The client in internal/payments/client.go that calls the external provider. It is the only place the timeout applies.

before_state: Requests to the payments provider failed after 5 seconds.
after_state: Requests to the payments provider fail after 30 seconds.

incidental.name: Everything else in the repository
incidental.description: No other behaviour changes. A walkthrough that explains the wider payments architecture here is overshooting the change.
